concepts.def: 24-29 April Dublin rebellion led by Pearse and Connolly; crushed by British, 15 leaders executed including Connolly tied to chair.
Won 73 of 105 Irish seats; refused Westminster, established Dail Eireann in Dublin January 1919.
Partition created Northern Ireland (six counties) and Southern Ireland; established devolved Stormont parliament.
Negotiated by Collins and Griffith; created Irish Free State as dominion with oath to crown; sparked civil war.
Pro-Treaty Free State forces under Collins defeated anti-Treaty IRA led by de Valera; Collins killed August 1922.
Declared by Costello government on Easter Monday; left Commonwealth, ended remaining ties with British Crown.
